portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

Bug Fix(es):

* Dampening ignored by attrd_updater -U for initial attribute creation (BZ#2224070)

* [FJ OSP17.1 Bug] Failed to replace a controller node. (BZ#2225668)

* Race condition when DC and attribute writer are both shutting down (BZ#2229013)
